info.description:
# AL-AZHARI LIBRARY API — Postman Collection v2.1

Authoritative Postman Collection generated directly from the canonical OpenAPI 3.0.3 contract (`src/config/openapi.ts`).

### Environments & Base URL
- Default Base URL: `{{baseUrl}}` (e.g. `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`)
- Root Base URL: `{{rootUrl}}` (e.g. `http://localhost:5000` for `/health` probes)

### Authentication
- **Bearer Token**: Protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` or `{{adminAccessToken}}`.
- **Refresh Cookie**: Session refresh endpoint `/api/v1/auth/refresh` operates via `Cookie: al_azhari_refresh={{refreshToken}}`.
- **Guest Token**: Storefront cart/checkout allows anonymous session tokens via `X-Guest-Token: {{guestToken}}`.

### Security & Hygiene
- Zero real credentials, production secrets, or JWT tokens are committed.
